raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 가상 브랜드 온빛의 데스크 램프 체험전을 안내해줘. 첨부 상품 사진을 실제로 참고해 짙은 초록색, 넓고 휘어진 가로 갓, 연결된 두 지지대와 타원형 받침의 특징을 보존하고 각 포스터에서 제품 전체가 한 번은 보여야 해. 표현 방식을 바꿀 수 있고 배경이나 포스터 배치는 보존 조건이 아니야. 실제 출시 정보나 업체 로고는 만들지 말아줘. 제품의 구조와 책상 위의 빛을 경험하는 행사로 느껴지게 해줘. 디지털 홍보용 16:9 가로 포스터를 서로 다른 전체 스타일 다섯 장으로 만들어줘. 본문 설명과 일정·장소·방문 조건·웹주소가 시선의 흐름 안에서 자연스럽게 이어져 읽혀야 해. 제목만 눈에 띄고 본문은 구석에 흩어지거나 작은 글자로 눌리지 않게 해줘. 단색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 상품 그림을 부가한 템플릿, 글자를 담기 위한 빈 실내 면의 구성은 제외해줘. 아래 문구를 각각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

저녁을 켜는 빛
ONBIT / DESK LAMP
조용한 빛으로 책상 위의 시간을 바꿉니다.
넓은 갓 아래로 퍼지는 빛과 짙은 초록의 구조를 가까이에서 살펴보세요.
온빛 데스크 램프 체험전
2027.04.09–04.11
금–일 13:00–19:00
성수 온빛 스튜디오
관람 무료 · 현장 구매 가능
예약 없이 방문
책과 종이를 가져와 직접 빛을 느껴보세요.
onbit.example/light

content_form.location: warm lamp light and folded cream paper plane

hierarchy.location: hero and title versus tiny long description and visit block

typography.observation: The italic heading and tracked English line are deliberate; native Hangul, punctuation and URL remain clean.

typography.location: single-line long description and lower participation lines

space.location: right endpoint of long description versus margins of title/event block

image_material.location: shade skin, support collars, paper creases and base shadow

emotion_control.location: green shadows and warm illuminated cream plane
emotion_control.observation: The theatrical diagonal light creates a focused product-experience mood, with clear material and paper relationships. The limited palette keeps that drama controlled and appropriate to a commercial lamp event.

ai_slop.location: product joints and folded-surface intersections

residuals: The long unwrapped description is too small at usage720 and ends very near the right frame; a nominally clean stack does not resolve its practical readability.

evidence.location: large lamp across upper-left and cream text wedge at right

evidence.location: lamp above open book, wording on lower pages and separate right sheet

content_form.location: left lamp/book and right illuminated page

typography.observation: Hangul shapes, periods, en dashes and the URL are clean. Weight changes distinguish event name and dates; the English heading tracking and slash spacing are deliberate.

typography.location: right descriptions and lower visit lines

space.location: panel seam and right text margins

image_material.location: shade surfaces, support joints, base contact and book pages

emotion_control.location: warm wooden desk, green lamp and cream copy
emotion_control.observation: The restrained warmth and focused illumination communicate a quiet evening reading experience suitable for a commercial lamp event; the legible information keeps the mood tied to participation.

ai_slop.location: lamp anatomy and surrounding desktop objects

residuals: Supporting copy is substantially smaller than the title, although this member keeps a continuous readable column at usage720.

Each copy entry once, exact Korean/English words/numbers/punctuation and meaningful word spaces, no added print,logo,QR,watermark or invented specs.
Separate single flat opaque landscape16:9 posters; no mockup or comparison sheet.

typography.observation: Words/punctuation are legible at native; the slanted headline and tracked English line have deliberate handling.
The full description is squeezed into a narrow small line; lower participation copy has little size reserve. Thumbnail keeps title/product while most event explanation and conditions collapse.

space.location: right cream field and left product
space.observation: The long description nearly spans the right field while the title and short program groups leave uneven right-side gaps. Large empty diagonal surfaces dominate around a familiar stacked information layout rather than organizing participation content.

image_material.location: shade coating/support collars/base and paper planes
image_material.observation: The source-like textured lamp is well constructed, and warm illumination/shadows agree across the cream textured surfaces and foreground folded paper. The object remains complete and mechanically coherent.

emotion_control.location: dark geometric green/cream stage
emotion_control.observation: Warm light against dark green gives a polished product mood, but the angular display feels broadly commercial and staged, with less specific human reading/visit atmosphere than M1 or M4.

ai_slop.location: geometric scene and product
ai_slop.observation: The planes are few and consistently lit, the supports/base are coherent, and no invented emblem, random motif or gibberish print appears. The main limitation is generic organization, rather than a malformed generated object.

residuals: The long description and lower participation copy are too small for comfortable natural reading at usage720.
Geometric paper staging changes backdrop and title slant while retaining the repeated left-product/right-information system.

M1 and M4 change the reading arrangement more substantially, but do not establish five independent visual systems.

evidence.location: full left lamp and geometric paper planes
evidence.observation: One complete forest-green curved-shade/two-support/oval-base lamp dominates the image. Angled green and cream planes, a warm light region and foreground paper are substantive nonglyph construction, and open style allows this product rendering.

evidence.location: illuminated cream diagonal plane
evidence.observation: The scene is a staged geometric paper/light construction, not an empty room wall. The product is large rather than a tiny subordinate addition; the warm paper surfaces relate to light, although the invitation remains a conventional right-side text stack.

evidence.location: right description and lower visit stack
evidence.observation: The long second description is a small single line across the right plane; visit conditions/invitation are much smaller than the headline. The complete copy can be read at native, but its use-size scale does not resolve the requested natural supporting-information flow.

evidence.location: whole poster and printed field

evidence.location: whole composition versus M2/M3
evidence.observation: Slanted headline and diagonal paper planes change details, but the full lamp left, headline/description right and lower right program/visit stack retain the same dominant scaffold as M3 and much of M2.

style.checked_requirement:
덕테이프 포스터로 가상 브랜드 온빛의 데스크 램프 체험전을 안내해줘. 첨부 상품 사진을 실제로 참고해 짙은 초록색, 넓고 휘어진 가로 갓, 연결된 두 지지대와 타원형 받침의 특징을 보존하고 각 포스터에서 제품 전체가 한 번은 보여야 해. 표현 방식을 바꿀 수 있고 배경이나 포스터 배치는 보존 조건이 아니야. 실제 출시 정보나 업체 로고는 만들지 말아줘. 제품의 구조와 책상 위의 빛을 경험하는 행사로 느껴지게 해줘. 디지털 홍보용 16:9 가로 포스터를 서로 다른 전체 스타일 다섯 장으로 만들어줘. 본문 설명과 일정·장소·방문 조건·웹주소가 시선의 흐름 안에서 자연스럽게 이어져 읽혀야 해. 제목만 눈에 띄고 본문은 구석에 흩어지거나 작은 글자로 눌리지 않게 해줘. 단색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 상품 그림을 부가한 템플릿, 글자를 담기 위한 빈 실내 면의 구성은 제외해줘. 아래 문구를 각각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

space.location: right cream field and left product
space.observation: The long description nearly spans the right field while the title and short program groups leave uneven right-side gaps. Large empty diagonal surfaces dominate around a familiar stacked information layout rather than organizing participation content.

image_material.location: shade coating/support collars/base and paper planes
image_material.observation: The source-like textured lamp is well constructed, and warm illumination/shadows agree across the cream textured surfaces and foreground folded paper. The object remains complete and mechanically coherent.

emotion_control.location: dark geometric green/cream stage
emotion_control.observation: Warm light against dark green gives a polished product mood, but the angular display feels broadly commercial and staged, with less specific human reading/visit atmosphere than M1 or M4.

ai_slop.location: geometric scene and product
ai_slop.observation: The planes are few and consistently lit, the supports/base are coherent, and no invented emblem, random motif or gibberish print appears. The main limitation is generic organization, rather than a malformed generated object.

source_fidelity.observations: The viewed source is recognizable in the complete left fixture: deep forest green, long horizontally curved shade, two cylindrical supports connected to the same shade and oval base. evidence.location: whole diptych
evidence.observation: Full desk view on left and close-up of light on a book on right create a two-panel reading system; title stays left and most program is right. This editing arrangement differs materially from the single-scene posters, while retaining the shared near-frontal lamp and warm desk palette.

evidence.location: whole engraved scene/right information field
evidence.observation: Woodcut-like green/ochre rendering and serif Korean/English change image and type voice, but lamp left, title/description right and divided lower program/visits align closely with M3 and much of M5. The material change does not fully change the visual system.

evidence.location: left lamp/right upper title/lower footer
evidence.observation: A pale outlined room removes props, but the oversized near-frontal lamp, right Gothic headline/description and two lower information groups preserve the common arrangement. It is closer to M5 structurally than its pale palette first suggests.

evidence.location: tilted book pages and separate right sheet
evidence.observation: The painted desk moves title/body/program onto angled foreground book pages and visits onto another sheet, materially changing viewpoint of the text and reading direction. The lamp remains a near-frontal left hero and book/warm-green atmosphere repeats M1 and M2.

evidence.location: large left lamp and right glowing plane
evidence.observation: Diagonal paper planes and slanted headline alter the backdrop/type details, but product viewpoint and scale, right stacked title/body/program/visits and green/cream warm light repeat M3 and the core M2 structure.

residuals: Five separate posters are present, but the set does not resolve five genuinely distinct whole styles. Three members retain a substantially shared product/reading scaffold; green/cream warmth and a near-frontal lamp recur across all five.
M1 diptych and M4 angled-page composition provide meaningful changes, while material/background/type substitutions elsewhere fall short of a five-direction professional set.
